issue_title: Performance regression: TBT spiked site-wide, pushing Home and Note Structurer below 85
issue_body:
# Performance Regression — TBT Spike (2026-09-20)

## Summary
Total Blocking Time (TBT) spiked significantly across **all five audited pages** between the 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-20 audits, causing performance scores on `/`, `/projects/note-structurer`, and `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` to fall below the 85 threshold.

## Affected pages

| Page | Prev score | Curr score | Prev TBT | Curr TBT |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/` | 88 | **83** | 60 ms | **202 ms** |
| `/about` | 90 | 90 | 36 ms | 90 ms |
| `/projects` | 90 | 88 | 80 ms | 183 ms |
| `/projects/note-structurer` | 85 | **80** | 81 ms | **200 ms** |
| `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | 80 | **78** | 82 ms | **199 ms** |

## Likely causes
- A newly introduced or updated script executing on the main thread
- A third-party resource (analytics, AI infra SDK, etc.) that became heavier
- Lack of JS code-splitting or deferred loading of non-critical modules

## Recommended actions
1. Run a Lighthouse trace locally and check the **Long Tasks** panel in Chrome DevTools to identify what is blocking the main thread.
2. Defer or lazy-load any non-critical third-party scripts.
3. Audit recent dependency updates for bundle-size regressions (e.g. check `npm ls` diff since 2026-09-19).
4. For `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` (score 78), also preload/convert sample screenshot images to WebP/AVIF to address the persistent LCP of ~4.5 s.

## Visuals
All pages are visually intact — this is a pure performance regression with no layout breakage.
